Counts are non-exclusive targeted route memberships. Shared redirects and incidental setup/reference pages are excluded. Cross-page workflows count for each targeted route. Link-only destinations are preserved as assertions but do not count as route exercise. Native shared auth asset coverage is assigned to login/register.

Static assertion candidates include branch-dependent assertions and helpers; they are not execution counts. Exact expressions and hashes appear in assertions.md and baseline.json.
